## 1. Identifier harmonisation

```{r unique-self-caregiver-reports}
n_distinct(df_clean$ResponseId_c, na.rm = TRUE)
n_distinct(df_clean$ResponseId_y, na.rm = TRUE)

# LinkCode duplicates

}

# ResponseId_y duplicates
```

## 2. Raw variable recoding

```{r recoding}
# Helper function
recode_factor_safe <- function(x, values, labels, var_name) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  values_chr <- as.character(values)

  unexpected <- setdiff(unique(x_chr[!is.na(x_chr)]), values_chr)

  if (length(unexpected) > 0) {
    warning(
      sprintf(
        "%s: unexpected value(s) %s not in mapping (%s) — these will become NA.",
        var_name,
        paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "),
        paste(values_chr, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  factor(x_chr, levels = values_chr, labels = labels)
}

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Binary N/Y variables
    adhd_c                = recode_factor_safe(adhd_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "adhd_c"),
    adhd_y                = recode_factor_safe(adhd_y, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "adhd_y"),
    hormonal_bc_status_c  = recode_factor_safe(hormonal_bc_status_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "hormonal_bc_status_c"),
    hormonal_bc_status_y  = recode_factor_safe(hormonal_bc_status_y, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "hormonal_bc_status_y"),
    adhd_med_status_c     = recode_factor_safe(adhd_med_status_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "adhd_med_status_c"),
    other_mental_neuro_c  = recode_factor_safe(other_mental_neuro_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "other_mental_neuro_c"),
    other_health_c        = recode_factor_safe(other_health_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "other_health_c"),
    medications_c         = recode_factor_safe(medications_c, values = c(1,2), labels = c("N","Y"), var_name = "medications_c"),

    # Gender
    gender_y = recode_factor_safe(gender_y, values = 1:6,
                 labels = c("girl","boy","trans_diverse","non_binary","prefer_not","self_describe"),
                 var_name = "gender_y"),
    gender_c = recode_factor_safe(gender_c, values = 1:6,
                 labels = c("girl","boy","trans_diverse","non_binary","prefer_not","self_describe"),
                 var_name = "gender_c"),

    # Caregiver relationship
    relationship_c = recode_factor_safe(relationship_c, values = 1:7,
                 labels = c("mother_stepmother","father_stepfather","grandparent",
                            "other_relative","foster_carer","legal_guardian_non_relative","other"),
                 var_name = "relationship_c"),

    # How diagnosed
    diagnosis_c = recode_factor_safe(diagnosis_c, values = 1:5,
                 labels = c("paed_psychiatrist","psychologist","self_identified","suspected","other"),
                 var_name = "diagnosis_c"),

    # Ethnicity / cultural background
    ethnicity_culture_c = recode_factor_safe(ethnicity_culture_c, values = 1:7,
                 labels = c("aboriginal_tsi","anglo_euro","e_se_sian","s_asian_middle_eastern",
                            "ss_african","multiple","other"),
                 var_name = "ethnicity_culture_c")
  )

pds_vars <- c("pds_c_1","pds_c_2","pds_c_3","pds_c_4",
              "pds_y_1","pds_y_2","pds_y_3","pds_y_4")

# PDS 0 recoded to NA
df_clean[pds_vars] <- lapply(df_clean[pds_vars], function(x) {
  x[x == 0] <- NA
  x
})

# Check recoded variables
vars <- c(
  "adhd_c","adhd_y",
  "hormonal_bc_status_c", 
  "hormonal_bc_status_y",
  "adhd_med_status_c",
  "other_mental_neuro_c", 
  "other_health_c", 
  "medications_c",
  "gender_y", 
  "gender_c",
  "relationship_c", 
  "diagnosis_c",
  "ethnicity_culture_c"
)

freq_table <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
  tab <- table(df_clean[[v]], useNA = "ifany")
  tibble(
    variable = v,
    level    = names(tab),
    n        = as.integer(tab),
    pct      = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)
  )
})

freq_table %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Frequency counts for categorical variables")
```

## 3. Constructed analytic variables pre-imputation

### 3.1 Assign ADHD status 

```{r assign-adhd-status}
# Check if there are any cases where caregiver ADHD status is missing but adolescent self-report is available
df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(ResponseId_c)) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    adhd_from_caregiver = sum(!is.na(adhd_c)),
    adhd_from_child = sum(is.na(adhd_c) & !is.na(adhd_y)),
    adhd_from_neither = sum(is.na(adhd_c) & is.na(adhd_y))
  )
# No cases found so ADHD status for main analysis based on caregiver only

# Assign ADHD status
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    adhd_status = adhd_c,
    adhd_status = factor(adhd_status, levels = c("N","Y"))
  )

# Check counts
table(df_clean$adhd_status, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r assign-adhd-med-status}

df_clean <- df_clean %>%

table(df_clean$adhd_med_status, useNA = "ifany")
```

### 3.4 Assign co-occurring autism

```{r assign-autism}
# Inspect all unique non-missing text responses first
df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT), other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT != "") %>%
  distinct(other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT) %>%
  arrange(other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Flag autism based on text response (covers "autism"/"autistic" and standalone "ASD")
autism_pattern <- "autis|\\basd\\b"

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    autism = case_when(
      # Text mentions autism -> Y
      grepl(autism_pattern, other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Y",
      # Caregiver did not answer the question (or no caregiver response) -> NA
      is.na(other_mental_neuro_c) ~ NA_character_,
      # Answered, but no autism mentioned -> N
      TRUE ~ "N"
    ),
    autism = factor(autism, levels = c("N", "Y"))
  )

# Check
table(df_clean$autism, useNA = "ifany")

# Cross-check against the parent question
table(df_clean$autism, df_clean$other_mental_neuro_c, useNA = "ifany")

# Review what text got matched
df_clean %>%
  filter(autism == "Y") %>%
  distinct(other_mental_neuro_c_2_TEXT) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

### 3.5 Assign socioeconomic disadvantage percentile based on postcode

```{r assign-sed-percentile}
postcode_sed_percentiles <- read_excel(here("Postcode Data", "postcode_sed_percentiles.xlsx"))

str(postcode_sed_percentiles)

# Check type/format consistency before joining
cat("Class of df_clean$postcode_c_1:", class(df_clean$postcode_c_1), "\n")
cat("Class of postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode:", class(postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode), "\n")

# Standardise both to 4-character strings (trim whitespace, pad leading zeros)
pad_postcode <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- str_remove(x, "\\.0+$")   # guards against "800.0" from numeric Excel cells
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, str_pad(x, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"))
}

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(postcode_c_1 = pad_postcode(postcode_c_1))

postcode_sed_percentiles <- postcode_sed_percentiles %>%
  mutate(postcode = pad_postcode(postcode))

# Check: all postcodes should now be exactly 4 characters
bad_length <- c(
  df_clean$postcode_c_1[!is.na(df_clean$postcode_c_1) & nchar(df_clean$postcode_c_1) != 4],
  postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode[!is.na(postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode) &
                                      nchar(postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode) != 4]
)

if (length(bad_length) > 0) {
  warning(
    sprintf("%d postcode(s) are not 4 characters long: %s",
            length(bad_length), paste(unique(bad_length), collapse = ", ")),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Check the lookup table itself is one row per postcode
dup_postcodes <- postcode_sed_percentiles %>%
  count(postcode) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dup_postcodes) > 0) {
  warning(
    sprintf(
      "%d postcode(s) appear more than once in postcode_sed_percentiles — a join on these will duplicate rows: %s",
      nrow(dup_postcodes),
      paste(dup_postcodes$postcode, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Check for df_clean postcodes with no match in the lookup table
unmatched_postcodes <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(postcode_c_1), !postcode_c_1 %in% postcode_sed_percentiles$postcode) %>%
  distinct(postcode_c_1)

if (nrow(unmatched_postcodes) > 0) {
  warning(
    sprintf(
      "%d unique postcode(s) in df_clean have no match in postcode_sed_percentiles: %s",
      nrow(unmatched_postcodes),
      paste(unmatched_postcodes$postcode_c_1, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Perform the join, checking row count doesn't change
n_before <- nrow(df_clean)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(
    postcode_sed_percentiles %>% select(postcode, sed_percentile),
    by = c("postcode_c_1" = "postcode")
  )

n_after <- nrow(df_clean)

if (n_after != n_before) {
  warning(
    sprintf(
      "Row count changed after join (%d -> %d) — the lookup table likely has duplicate postcodes.",
      n_before, n_after
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

head(df_clean$sed_percentile)

df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(ResponseId_c)) %>%
  summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(sed_percentile)))
```

#### 3.7.4 Set invalid menarche months (>11 or NA) to 0

```{r invalid-menarche-months-to-0}
# Count what will be changed (before recoding)
check_months_recode <- function(years, months, label) {
  tibble(
    report = label,
    n_rows = length(months),
    months_gt11 = sum(months > 11, na.rm = TRUE),
    months_gt11_years_present = sum(months > 11 & !is.na(years), na.rm = TRUE),
    months_na_total = sum(is.na(months)),
    months_na_years_present = sum(is.na(months) & !is.na(years)),
    months_na_years_also_missing = sum(is.na(months) & is.na(years))
  )
}

months_recode_summary <- bind_rows(
  check_months_recode(df_clean$menarche_age_c_1, df_clean$menarche_age_c_2, "caregiver"),
  check_months_recode(df_clean$menarche_age_y_1, df_clean$menarche_age_y_2, "young person")
)
months_recode_summary

# Recode: months -> 0 only where years is present
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    menarche_age_y_2 = case_when(
      is.na(menarche_age_y_1) ~ NA_real_,                 
      is.na(menarche_age_y_2) ~ 0,                        
      menarche_age_y_2 > 11 ~ 0,                        
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(menarche_age_y_2)
    ),
    menarche_age_c_2 = case_when(
      is.na(menarche_age_c_1) ~ NA_real_,
      is.na(menarche_age_c_2) ~ 0,
      menarche_age_c_2 > 11 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(menarche_age_c_2)
    )
  )

table(df_clean$menarche_age_y_2, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_clean$menarche_age_c_2, useNA = "ifany")

# 3. Checks
stopifnot(
  sum(is.na(df_clean$menarche_age_c_2) & !is.na(df_clean$menarche_age_c_1)) == 0,
  sum(is.na(df_clean$menarche_age_y_2) & !is.na(df_clean$menarche_age_y_1)) == 0,
  sum(df_clean$menarche_age_c_2 > 11, na.rm = TRUE) == 0,
  sum(df_clean$menarche_age_y_2 > 11, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
)
```


### 4.2 Apply exclusions and count

```{r apply-exclusions}
# Helper: counts total and non-missing ResponseId_c / ResponseId_y
count_ids <- function(d) {
  has_c <- !is.na(d$ResponseId_c) & d$ResponseId_c != ""
  has_y <- !is.na(d$ResponseId_y) & d$ResponseId_y != ""
  tibble(
    n        = nrow(d),
    has_c    = sum(has_c),
    has_y    = sum(has_y),
    has_both = sum(has_c & has_y)
  )
}

# Helper: print one line of counts
report <- function(label, d) {
  x <- count_ids(d)
  cat(sprintf("%-32s N = %d | ResponseId_c = %d | ResponseId_y = %d | both = %d\n",
              label, x$n, x$has_c, x$has_y, x$has_both))
}

# Original sample
report("Original sample", df_clean)
flow <- count_ids(df_clean) %>% mutate(step = "Original", .before = 1)

# Exclude no consent
excl <- df_clean %>% filter(!is.na(no_consent) & no_consent == TRUE)
df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(is.na(no_consent) | no_consent != TRUE)

report("Excluded: no consent", excl)
report("Remaining", df_clean)
flow <- bind_rows(
  flow,
  count_ids(excl)     %>% mutate(step = "Excluded: no consent", .before = 1),
  count_ids(df_clean) %>% mutate(step = "Remaining after consent", .before = 1)
)
cat("\n")

# Exclude missing ADHD status
excl <- df_clean %>% filter(!is.na(no_adhd_status) & no_adhd_status == TRUE)
df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(is.na(no_adhd_status) | no_adhd_status != TRUE)

report("Excluded: missing ADHD status", excl)
report("Remaining", df_clean)
flow <- bind_rows(
  flow,
  count_ids(excl)     %>% mutate(step = "Excluded: missing ADHD status", .before = 1),
  count_ids(df_clean) %>% mutate(step = "Remaining after ADHD status", .before = 1)
)
cat("\n")

# Exclude out-of-range age
excl <- df_clean %>% filter(!is.na(age_out_of_range) & age_out_of_range == TRUE)
df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(is.na(age_out_of_range) | age_out_of_range != TRUE)

report("Excluded: out-of-range age", excl)
report("Remaining", df_clean)
flow <- bind_rows(
  flow,
  count_ids(excl)     %>% mutate(step = "Excluded: out-of-range age", .before = 1),
  count_ids(df_clean) %>% mutate(step = "Remaining after age", .before = 1)
)

# Summary table
print(flow, n = Inf)
```

## 5. Create versions for descriptives and sensitivity analyses

### 5.1 Derived variables

```{r obs-derived-variables}
# Scale ranges
scale_spec <- list(
  pds_c  = list(items = paste0("pds_c_", 1:5),   min = 1, max = 4),
  pds_y  = list(items = paste0("pds_y_", 1:5),   min = 1, max = 4),
  ers_c  = list(items = paste0("ers_c_", 1:21),  min = 0, max = 4),
  ers_y  = list(items = paste0("ers_y_", 1:21),  min = 0, max = 4),
  smfq_c = list(items = paste0("smfq_c_", 1:13), min = 0, max = 2),
  smfq_y = list(items = paste0("smfq_y_", 1:13), min = 0, max = 2),
  swan_c = list(items = paste0("swan_c_", 1:18), min = -3, max = 3)
)

# Check 1: all item columns exist and are numeric
all_items <- unlist(lapply(scale_spec, `[[`, "items"))
stopifnot(all(all_items %in% names(df_clean)))

non_numeric <- all_items[!sapply(df_clean[all_items], is.numeric)]
if (length(non_numeric) > 0) {
  stop("Non-numeric scale items: ", paste(non_numeric, collapse = ", "))
}

# Check 2: observed range per scale vs expected range
range_check <- purrr::imap_dfr(scale_spec, function(s, nm) {
  vals <- unlist(df_clean[s$items])
  tibble(
    scale        = nm,
    expected_min = s$min,
    expected_max = s$max,
    observed_min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_of_range = sum(vals < s$min | vals > s$max, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})
print(range_check)

if (any(range_check$n_out_of_range > 0)) {
  stop("Scale items outside expected range. Check range_check and your coding.")
}

# Prorated sum: requires >= 80% of items; otherwise NA
prorated_sum <- function(df, items, threshold = 0.8) {
  m <- as.matrix(df[items])
  n_present <- rowSums(!is.na(m))
  ifelse(
    n_present / length(items) >= threshold,
    rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE) * length(items),
    NA_real_
  )
}

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    pds_total   = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$pds_c$items),
    pds_total_y = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$pds_y$items),
    ers_total   = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$ers_c$items),
    ers_total_y = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$ers_y$items),
    smfq_total   = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$smfq_c$items),
    smfq_total_y = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$smfq_y$items),
    swan_total  = prorated_sum(., scale_spec$swan_c$items)
  )

# Check 3: totals fall inside the possible range
total_check <- tibble(
  total = c("pds_total", "pds_total_y", "ers_total", "ers_total_y",
            "smfq_total", "smfq_total_y", "swan_total"),
  spec  = c("pds_c", "pds_y", "ers_c", "ers_y", "smfq_c", "smfq_y", "swan_c")
) %>%
  mutate(
    lo = map_dbl(spec, ~ scale_spec[[.x]]$min * length(scale_spec[[.x]]$items)),
    hi = map_dbl(spec, ~ scale_spec[[.x]]$max * length(scale_spec[[.x]]$items)),
    observed_min = map_dbl(total, ~ min(df_clean[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    observed_max = map_dbl(total, ~ max(df_clean[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_missing    = map_int(total, ~ sum(is.na(df_clean[[.x]])))
  )
print(total_check)
stopifnot(all(total_check$observed_min >= total_check$lo - 1e-8),
          all(total_check$observed_max <= total_check$hi + 1e-8))

# BMI
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    height_m = height_c_1 / 100,
    bmi = weight_c_1 / (height_m^2)
  )

# Pubertal timing
pds_model_c <- lm(pds_total ~ age_cont, data = df_clean, na.action = na.exclude)
df_clean$pubertal_timing <- resid(pds_model_c)

pds_model_y <- lm(pds_total_y ~ age_cont_y, data = df_clean, na.action = na.exclude)
df_clean$pubertal_timing_y <- resid(pds_model_y)
```

```{r c-block-missingness}
# Block missingness in psychological scales and PDS items
check_block_missingness <- function(df, item_prefix) {
  items <- df %>% select(starts_with(item_prefix)) %>% names()

  df %>%
    select(all_of(items)) %>%
    mutate(n_missing = rowSums(is.na(across(everything()))),
           n_items   = length(items)) %>%
    count(n_missing) %>%
    mutate(scale = item_prefix, n_items_total = length(items))
}
```

### 7.5 Confirm monotone missingness pattern

```{r c-monotone-pattern}
# Confirm the monotone missingness pattern (order: ERS -> SMFQ -> SWAN)
# A scale counts as "answered" if any of its items is non-missing
df_impute <- df_impute %>%
  mutate(
    has_ers  = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("ers_c_"))))  > 0,
    has_smfq = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("smfq_c_")))) > 0,
    has_swan = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("swan_c_")))) > 0,
    survey_dropout_point = case_when(
      has_ers  &  has_smfq &  has_swan ~ "Completed",
      has_ers  &  has_smfq & !has_swan ~ "Stopped before SWAN",
      has_ers  & !has_smfq & !has_swan ~ "Stopped before SMFQ",
      !has_ers & !has_smfq & !has_swan ~ "Stopped before ERS",
      TRUE                             ~ "Non-monotone"
    )
  )

table(df_impute$survey_dropout_point)

if (any(df_impute$survey_dropout_point == "Non-monotone")) {
  warning("Non-monotone missingness found; inspect these rows.", call. = FALSE)
}

# Pattern of scales answered (1 = any item answered, 0 = none)
df_impute %>%
  count(ERS = as.integer(has_ers),
        SMFQ = as.integer(has_smfq),
        SWAN = as.integer(has_swan))

# Explicit monotone checks (both should be 0)
sum(!df_impute$has_ers  & (df_impute$has_smfq | df_impute$has_swan))
sum(!df_impute$has_smfq & df_impute$has_swan)
```

### 7.6 Regression to assess potential for missing at random

```{r c-missingness-relationships}
check_missingness <- function(df, outcome_var,
                              predictors = c("age_cont", "sed_percentile",
                                             "adhd_status", "weight_c_1"),
                              min_events = 5) {

  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, outcome_var)
  df <- df %>% mutate(.missing = as.integer(is.na(.data[[outcome_var]])))

  cat(strrep("=", 40), "\n")
  cat("CAREGIVER MISSINGNESS CHECK:", outcome_var, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 40), "\n")

  # 1. Missingness frequency
  cat("\nMissingness frequency (0 = observed, 1 = missing):\n")
  print(table(df$.missing, useNA = "ifany"))

  n_miss <- sum(df$.missing)
  n_obs  <- sum(df$.missing == 0)

  # 2. Descriptives by missingness
  is_num    <- vapply(predictors, function(p) is.numeric(df[[p]]), logical(1))
  num_preds <- predictors[is_num]
  cat_preds <- predictors[!is_num]

  if (length(num_preds) > 0) {
    cat("\nNumeric predictors by missingness:\n")
    df %>%
      group_by(.missing) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        across(all_of(num_preds),
               list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                    sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
               .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      print(width = Inf)
  }

  for (p in cat_preds) {
    cat("\n", p, "x missingness:\n")
    print(table(df[[p]], df$.missing, useNA = "ifany"))
  }

  # 3. Skip the regression if too few cases in either group
  if (n_miss < min_events || n_obs < min_events) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nRegression skipped: only %d missing / %d observed (minimum %d each).\n\n",
      n_miss, n_obs, min_events))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # 4. Logistic regression on complete cases
  model_df  <- df %>% select(.missing, all_of(predictors)) %>% drop_na()
  n_dropped <- nrow(df) - nrow(model_df)
  events    <- sum(model_df$.missing)

  cat(sprintf("\nLogistic regression: %d rows used, %d dropped for missing predictors.\n",
              nrow(model_df), n_dropped))
  cat(sprintf("Missing cases in model: %d (%.1f per predictor)\n",
              events, events / length(predictors)))
  if (events / length(predictors) < 10) {
    cat("Note: fewer than 10 events per predictor; estimates may be unstable (exploratory).\n")
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      glm(reformulate(predictors, response = ".missing"),
          data = model_df, family = binomial()),
      warning = function(w) {
        cat("GLM warning:", conditionMessage(w), "\n")
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("GLM failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(fit)) print(summary(fit))
  cat("\n")
  invisible(fit)
}

# Caregiver
check_missingness(df_impute, "ers_c_1")
check_missingness(df_impute, "smfq_c_1")
check_missingness(df_impute, "swan_c_1")
```

```{r y-missingness-relationships}
  n_obs  <- sum(df$.missing == 0)

  # 2. Descriptives by missingness
  is_num    <- vapply(predictors, function(p) is.numeric(df[[p]]), logical(1))

  cat_preds <- predictors[!is_num]

  if (length(num_preds) > 0) {

                    sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
               .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%

  }

  for (p in cat_preds) {
    cat("\n", p, "x missingness:\n")

  }

  # 3. Skip the regression if too few cases in either group
  if (n_miss < min_events || n_obs < min_events) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nRegression skipped: only %d missing / %d observed (minimum %d each).\n\n",
      n_miss, n_obs, min_events))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # 4. Logistic regression on complete cases
  model_df  <- df %>% select(.missing, all_of(predictors)) %>% drop_na()
  n_dropped <- nrow(df) - nrow(model_df)

  cat(sprintf("\nLogistic regression: %d rows used, %d dropped for missing predictors.\n",
              nrow(model_df), n_dropped))
  cat(sprintf("Missing cases in model: %d (%.1f per predictor)\n",
              events, events / length(predictors)))
```
